---
title: "Lag between publication and GWAS Catalog deposition"
subtitle: "How long after publication are GWAS papers added to the GWAS Catalog?"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup_knitr, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Introduction

Studies are added to the GWAS Catalog at a different time to when they are published. 
Often this is after the publication date, but sometimes it is before. 

This means the number of publications in more recent years is censored (incomplete).
To decide how recent a publication can be while still expecting it to be in the Catalog, this analysis measures the gap between each study's publication
date (`DATE`) and the date it was added to the Catalog (`DATE_ADDED_TO_CATALOG`).
It then checks whether that gap has changed over time.

```{r load_packages, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load GWAS Catalog study information

```{r load_data}
# GWAS Catalog study-level metadata (release 2026-09-13)
gwas_study_info <- data.table::fread(
  here::here("data/gwas_catalog/gwas-catalog-v1.0.3.1-studies-r2026-09-13.tsv"),
  quote = ""
)

# Replace spaces in column names with underscores so they are easier to use
gwas_study_info <-
  gwas_study_info |>
  rename_all(~ gsub(" ", "_", .x))
```

## Calculate the publication-to-catalog gap

```{r months_gap_function}
# Number of months between two dates (fractional months)
months_gap <- function(start_date, end_date) {

  # Convert input dates to Date class
  start_date <- lubridate::ymd(start_date)
  end_date   <- lubridate::ymd(end_date)

  # Interval length in months
  months_gap <-
    lubridate::time_length(
      lubridate::interval(start_date, end_date),
      unit = "months"
    )

  return(months_gap)
}
```

```{r time_gap_summary}
# One row per publication: its publication date, the date it was added to
# the Catalog, the gap between them (months), and the publication year
time_gap_summary <-
  gwas_study_info |>
  distinct(PUBMED_ID, DATE_ADDED_TO_CATALOG, DATE) |>
  mutate(catalog_gap = months_gap(DATE, DATE_ADDED_TO_CATALOG)) |>
  mutate(PUB_YEAR = lubridate::year(DATE))
```

## Has the gap changed over time?

### Correlation between publication year and gap

Spearman correlation between publication year and the publication-to-catalog
gap, first for all years, then restricted to more recent publications.

```{r cor_all_years}
# All publication years
time_gap_summary |>
  summarise(cor_year = cor(PUB_YEAR,
                           catalog_gap,
                           use = "complete.obs",
                           method = "spearman"))
```

```{r cor_2015_on}
# Publications from 2015 onwards
time_gap_summary |>
  filter(PUB_YEAR >= 2015) |>
  summarise(cor_year = cor(PUB_YEAR,
                           catalog_gap,
                           use = "complete.obs",
                           method = "spearman"))
```

```{r cor_2010_on}
# Publications from 2010 onwards
time_gap_summary |>
  filter(PUB_YEAR >= 2010) |>
  summarise(cor_year = cor(PUB_YEAR,
                           catalog_gap,
                           use = "complete.obs",
                           method = "spearman"))
```

### Gap by publication year

Summary of the gap (in **years**) for each publication year.

```{r gap_by_year}
time_gap_summary |>
  group_by(PUB_YEAR) |>
  summarise(
    median_gap  = median(catalog_gap, na.rm = TRUE) / 12,
    quantile_95 = quantile(catalog_gap, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) / 12,
    min         = min(catalog_gap, na.rm = TRUE) / 12,
    max         = max(catalog_gap, na.rm = TRUE) / 12
  )
```

```{r gap_by_year_plot}
# Distribution of the gap (months) for each publication year
time_gap_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = PUB_YEAR,
             y = catalog_gap)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = PUB_YEAR),
               outlier.shape = NA,
               alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    y = "Publication-to-catalog gap (months)",
    x = "Publication year"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

## Distribution of the gap for 2011–2020 publications

The analysis is now restricted to publications:

* **after 2010**, once the GWAS Catalog was established, and
* **before 2021**, so that recent publications that have not been curated
  yet do not bias the gap downwards.

```{r filter_years}
time_gap_summary <-
  time_gap_summary |>
  filter(PUB_YEAR < 2021 & PUB_YEAR > 2010)
```

### Quantiles of the gap

```{r quantiles}
# Empirical quantiles of the gap (months) on a fine grid
quantiles <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.001)

quantile_data <-
  tibble(
    quantile = quantiles,
    months = quantile(
      time_gap_summary$catalog_gap,
      probs = quantiles,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r quantile_plot}
# Cumulative distribution of the gap, in years (first 10 years)
quantile_data |>
  mutate(years = months / 12) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = years,
             y = quantile)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    y = "Quantile",
    x = "Publication-to-catalog gap (years)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  xlim(0, 10) +
  theme_classic()
```

### Quantiles at specific gaps

Which quantiles correspond to a gap of exactly 12 and 9 months?

```{r quantile_at_12_months}
quantile_data |> filter(months == 12)
# Earlier result:
#   quantile months
#   0.83     12
#   0.84     12
```

```{r quantile_at_9_months}
quantile_data |> filter(months == 9)
```

## Figure: publication-to-catalog lag

Cumulative distribution of the lag, with reference lines at the share of
studies added within 9 months, 1 year and 2 years of publication.
The figure is saved to `figures/gwas_cat_lag.png`.

```{r lag_figure, fig.width = 12.3, fig.height = 5.8}

plot <-
  quantile_data |>
  mutate(years = months / 12) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = years,
             y = quantile)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    y = "Quantile",
    x = "Publication-to-catalog lag (years)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +

  # 2 years
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.92,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 0.15, y = 0.96,
           label = "92% within 2 years of pub",
           color = "red",
           hjust = 0,
           size = 20,
           size.unit = "pt") +

  # 1 year
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.87,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 1.5,
           y = 0.84,
           label = "87% within 1 year of pub",
           color = "blue",
           hjust = 0,
           size = 20,
           size.unit = "pt") +

  # 9 months
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.77,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  annotate("text",
           x = 1.5,
           y = 0.74,
           label = "77% within 9 months of pub",
           color = "blue",
           hjust = 0,
           size = 20,
           size.unit = "pt") +

  xlim(0, 5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 25)
  )

plot
```

```{r save_figure}
ggsave(plot,
       filename = here::here("figures/gwas_cat_lag.png"),
       device = ragg::agg_png,
       dpi = 440,
       width = 12.3,
       height = 5.8,
       units = "in"
)
```

## Check does this pattern look different for priority conditions? 

```{r}

disease_mapping_with_cause <-
data.table::fread(
here::here("output/icd_map/gwas_study_gbd_causes.csv")
)

priority_condition_papers <-
  disease_mapping_with_cause  |> 
  filter(include == TRUE)  |>
  pull(PUBMED_ID) |>
  unique()

length(priority_condition_papers)

# Calculate the gap between Catalog deposition date them (months), and the publication year
time_gap_summary <-
  gwas_study_info |>
  filter(PUBMED_ID %in% priority_condition_papers) |>
  distinct(PUBMED_ID, DATE_ADDED_TO_CATALOG, DATE) |>
  mutate(catalog_gap = months_gap(DATE, DATE_ADDED_TO_CATALOG)) |>
  mutate(PUB_YEAR = lubridate::year(DATE))

# Summary of the gap (in **years**) for each publication year.
time_gap_summary |>
  group_by(PUB_YEAR) |>
  summarise(
    median_gap  = median(catalog_gap, na.rm = TRUE) / 12,
    quantile_95 = quantile(catalog_gap, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE) / 12,
    min         = min(catalog_gap, na.rm = TRUE) / 12,
    max         = max(catalog_gap, na.rm = TRUE) / 12
  )

time_gap_summary <-
  time_gap_summary |>
  filter(PUB_YEAR < 2021 & PUB_YEAR > 2010)

quantiles <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.001)

priority_conditions_quantile_data <-
  tibble(
    quantile = quantiles,
    months = quantile(
      time_gap_summary$catalog_gap,
      probs = quantiles,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  rows_append(
    tibble(
      quantile = c(1),
      months = c(120)
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(type = "Priority Conditions") 

all_quantile_data <-
rbind(quantile_data |>
      mutate(type = "All GWAS Catalog Papers"),
      priority_conditions_quantile_data)

plot <-
all_quantile_data |>
  mutate(years = months / 12) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = years,
             y = quantile,
             colour = type)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    y = "Quantile",
    x = "Publication-to-catalog lag (years)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("All GWAS Catalog Papers" = "black",
                        "Priority Conditions" = "red")) +
  xlim(0, 10) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

plot

ggsave(plot,
       filename = here::here("figures/gwas_cat_lag_by_type.png"),
       device = ragg::agg_png,
       dpi = 440,
       width = 12.3,
       height = 5.8,
       units = "in"
)

```
